import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the dynamic libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define constants and types
N = 100  # Number of data points
K = 10   # Workspace size
t = 2.0  # Threshold multiplier

# Allocate GSL workspaces and vectors
class GSLFilterImpulseWorkspace(ctypes.Structure):
    pass

class GSLVector(ctypes.Structure):
    pass

class GSLVectorInt(ctypes.Structure):
    pass

# Function prototypes
gsl_filter_impulse_alloc = gsl.gsl_filter_impulse_alloc
gsl_filter_impulse_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl_filter_impulse_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(GSLFilterImpulseWorkspace)

gsl_filter_impulse_free = gsl.gsl_filter_impulse_free
gsl_filter_impulse_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLFilterImpulseWorkspace)]

gsl_vector_alloc = gsl.gsl_vector_alloc
gsl_vector_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl_vector_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(GSLVector)

gsl_vector_free = gsl.gsl_vector_free
gsl_vector_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLVector)]

gsl_vector_int_alloc = gsl.gsl_vector_int_alloc
gsl_vector_int_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl_vector_int_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(GSLVectorInt)

gsl_vector_int_free = gsl.gsl_vector_int_free
gsl_vector_int_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLVectorInt)]

gsl_vector_set = gsl.gsl_vector_set
gsl_vector_set.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLVector), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_double]

gsl_vector_get = gsl.gsl_vector_get
gsl_vector_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLVector), ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl_vector_get.restype = ctypes.c_double

gsl_vector_int_get = gsl.gsl_vector_int_get
gsl_vector_int_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLVectorInt), ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl_vector_int_get.restype = ctypes.c_int

gsl_filter_impulse = gsl.gsl_filter_impulse
gsl_filter_impulse.argtypes = [
    ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_double,
    ctypes.POINTER(GSLVector), ctypes.POINTER(GSLVector),
    ctypes.POINTER(GSLVector), ctypes.POINTER(GSLVector),
    ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t), ctypes.POINTER(GSLVectorInt),
    ctypes.POINTER(GSLFilterImpulseWorkspace)
]

def assert_test():
    # Allocate workspace and vectors
    w = gsl_filter_impulse_alloc(K)
    x = gsl_vector_alloc(N)
    y = gsl_vector_alloc(N)
    xmedian = gsl_vector_alloc(N)
    xsigma = gsl_vector_alloc(N)
    ioutlier = gsl_vector_int_alloc(N)

    # Generate noisy sinusoidal signal with outliers
    rng = np.random.default_rng()
    for i in range(N):
        xi = 10.0 * np.sin(2.0 * np.pi * i / N)
        ei = rng.normal(0, 2.0)
        u = rng.uniform()
        outlier = 15.0 * np.sign(ei) if u < 0.01 else 0.0
        gsl_vector_set(x, i, xi + ei + outlier)

    # Apply impulse filter
    noutlier = ctypes.c_size_t()
    gsl_filter_impulse(
        0, 1, t, x, y, xmedian, xsigma, ctypes.byref(noutlier), ioutlier, w
    )

    # Validate output
    for i in range(N):
        xi = gsl_vector_get(x, i)
        yi = gsl_vector_get(y, i)
        xmedi = gsl_vector_get(xmedian, i)
        xsigmai = gsl_vector_get(xsigma, i)
        outlier = gsl_vector_int_get(ioutlier, i)

        assert isinstance(xi, float)
        assert isinstance(yi, float)
        assert isinstance(xmedi, float)
        assert isinstance(xsigmai, float)
        assert isinstance(outlier, int)

    # Free resources
    gsl_vector_free(x)
    gsl_vector_free(y)
    gsl_vector_free(xmedian)
    gsl_vector_free(xsigma)
    gsl_vector_int_free(ioutlier)
    gsl_filter_impulse_free(w)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
